reproduction.setup: Prepare separate baseCommit and candidate checkouts with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build. Build each iOS artifact with AGENT_DEVICE_XCUITEST_INCLUDE_UNIT_TESTS=1 and its own AGENT_DEVICE_IOS_RUNNER_DERIVED_PATH. Apply instrumentationPatch and use profileTestsSwift as UnitTests/RunnerTests+TextEntryLatencyTests.swift for the manual native profile; adapt the readiness-helper hunk to its renamed function on the candidate. Run sequentially without competing builds/tests. The uninstrumented final selection is recorded separately.

pixelResamplingDisposition.reason: Approximately 2.5 ms integer gain, fractional slowdown, and cognitive complexity 24 above the gate threshold. Final source retains the original resampler and tests. Resampling samples and mutation evidence describe the isolated rejected candidate only.

mutation.edit: Warmup uses textValueRead(for: activeTarget.element) instead of resolving the bound input.
mutation.detectedBy: New masked-removal test and existing readable-removal test record stale-handle XCTest failures; replacement and stable masked cases remain passing.

reviewFollowup.initialLaunchFailure: Runner killed before test bootstrap; reset simulator and control passed. Initial cause remains unproven.

ciFollowup.failure: Nine eager-closure assertions failed because png-worker-client statically imported the existing encoder, adding one eager module to consumer closures.
ciFollowup.fix: Import encoder inside the async inline callback; worker path unchanged.
ciFollowup.ciStatus: Focused reproduction passes locally; new GitHub coverage/integration/native/device verdicts remain CI obligations.

rebaseComparison.rebaseProof: All five patches match in range-diff; apple and capture-kit contents match before/after rebase. The subsequent CI fix only makes the inline encoder import lazy.
rebaseComparison.method: Separate frozen-lockfile builds and source daemons. Device runs use the same T3 0.21.25 CLI, required host config/session flags, and explicit URL/token overrides to each isolated source HTTP daemon. CLI snapshots independently verify fill/append values. Four ordinary rounds and three two-step Maestro flow samples per revision. Raw/SDK runs execute A-B-A-B, each with ten warmups then 100 alternating samples. Final PNG runs execute sequentially, with two warmups then 20 samples; every decoded RGBA byte matches. Native sources are unchanged across rebase.
rebaseComparison.limitations: Small device sample; host variation is visible and does not establish statistical equivalence or a new speedup. SDK overhead includes fresh process probes. Maestro numbers include assert-visible and tap, not just the native operation. Startup/stop are outside the timed rows.
rebaseComparison.selectorFlow:
appId: dev.e2e.benchmark
---
- assertVisible:
    id: email-input
- tapOn:
    id: email-input
rebaseComparison.cleanup: All three source device sessions closed with shutdown; source daemons stopped gracefully; both disposable comparison checkouts removed. Mutant build retired. Root SHA/status preserved through experiments.
rebaseComparison.excludedExploratoryRuns: Earlier daemon/PNG timing batches and the PNG baseline rerun overlapping checkout cleanup are excluded. Only the serial final PNG pair and A-B-A-B daemon runs above support this follow-up.
